N1.s: Porabili ste vseh %lld brezplačnih cutlingov. Če nadaljujete v Cutlingu in ga odklenete, se shrani tudi ta.
N1.back: Used-up you-have all 5 free cutlings. If you-continue in Cutling and it you-unlock, itself saves also this-one.
N1.why: First sentence is S3's word for word, so Siri says what the sheet says; 'Če nadaljujete' answers the system's own continue choice, and 'tudi ta' names the item they asked to save.

N2.s: Porabili ste vseh %lld brezplačnih cutlingov. Odprite in odklenite Cutling, da shranite več.
N2.back: Used-up you-have all 5 free cutlings. Open and unlock Cutling, so-that you-save more.
N2.why: Same opening as N1 and S3; two imperatives share one object, which keeps it at 89 with 5 where 'Odprite Cutling in ga odklenite' ran to 92.

N3.s: Shranjeno. Še en in bo polno.
N3.back: Saved. Still one and will-be full.
N3.why: 'Še en in bo polno' is how Slovenians say one more fits (a lift, a car park); en agrees with the unspoken masculine cutling; 29 characters.

N4.why: Picks up the 'polno' of N3, so the step from four to five reads as one story; the pair keeps the batch's '%lld od %lld' (S29, M4) and its noun-free count needs no plural forms.

N5.s: Polno: %lld od %lld. Odklenite, da se shrani.
N5.back: Full: 5 of 5. Unlock, so-that itself saves.
N5.why: Same status as N4 so the bar names the state the person just saw; 'da se shrani' says the item saves on unlocking without a 'we'; 39 characters.

N6.why: The bare imperative of S15 and M1, as Slovenian iOS buttons are written (Nadaljuj, Končano).

N7.s: Porabili ste vseh %lld brezplačnih cutlingov. Ko Cutling odklenete, se shrani tudi ta.
N7.back: Used-up you-have all 5 free cutlings. When Cutling you-unlock, itself saves also this-one.
N7.why: S3's opening again; 'Ko Cutling odklenete' is S28's word order, and 'tudi ta' points at the item in the form just below.

N8.s: Ta cutling vas čaka. Odprite in odklenite Cutling, da se shrani.
N8.back: This cutling you is-waiting-for. Open and unlock Cutling, so-that itself saves.
N8.why: 'vas čaka' is what a parcel at the post office does in Slovenian: kept, not yet saved, so it never claims a save that has not happened; second sentence matches N2.
